summary: JIADE Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 50,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.24 per share for $12M aggregate proceeds, with an initial closing of $3.36M (14,000,000 shares) on May 5, 2026, and a second closing of $8.64M by June 30, 2026 subject to share consolidation and charter amendments. The offering was approved by the board and conducted under an effective F-3 shelf. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation like a restructuring or going-private transaction. No special-situation dynamics apply; the filing is an ordinary shelf takedown.
